thread.title: Apple Escalates the Payment War with PayPal

title: Apple Escalates the Payment War with PayPal
text: Apple Escalates the Payment War with PayPal More Following a launch in Germany earlier in December, the Apple Pay service is available in 33 countries, according to Apple (AAPL). The arrival of Apple Pay in Germany widens the battleground for Apple and PayPal (PYPL) in the digital payments world. PayPal offers its digital payments service in more than 200 countries, including Germany. PayPal expanded in Germany by introducing its business loans service in the country. Square (SQ), another emerging digital payments provider, operates in five counties. Currently, Square doesn’t operate in Germany.
